applies: Skilled Worker Stream (Skilled Worker in Manitoba, Skilled Worker Overseas) and International Education Stream

experience.note: Full years of full-time work (30+ hours a week, periods of 6 months or more with an employer) in the last 5 years, not rounded up. 100 more points if fully recognized by the Manitoba licensing body of a regulated profession or trade.

options: Two post-secondary programs of at least two years each
One post-secondary program of three years or more
One post-secondary program of two years

connection: Previous authorized work experience in Manitoba (six months or more)
Completed post-secondary program in Manitoba (two years or more)
Completed post-secondary program in Manitoba (one year)
Close friend or distant relative in Manitoba
demand: Ongoing employment in Manitoba for six months or more with a long-term job offer from the same employer
Invitation to Apply under a Strategic Initiative
adaptability.note: Only the highest-scoring connection counts. Regional development points (destination outside Winnipeg) are added to another Manitoba connection, except Manitoba Demand.

risk.note: No deduction for a close relative in another province or a previous immigration application to another province.
